phases.objective: Project one public system-tool descriptor per visible tool_name and select one active endpoint binding by endpoint_key without weakening Catalog V2 collision protection.

e2e_journeys.actor: authenticated platform admin or authenticated tenant member
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The caller receives one descriptor for the public tool name and the call reaches only the explicitly selected visible endpoint binding.
steps: Resolve the caller principal and derive the allowed platform endpoint scope classes.
Apply the tenant ownership clause and tenant blocked-tool policy before descriptor projection.
Group visible active rows by tool_name and expose one descriptor with a stable endpoint_key enum.
Require endpoint_key only when the visible public name has more than one active binding.
Select the exact matching endpoint row before passing path_params, query, body, headers, timeout, and readback context to the existing dispatcher.
Return the dispatcher result through the existing system-layer response contract.
assertions: Catalog V2 receives exactly one descriptor for github_rest_endpoint_dispatch and does not encounter a descriptor-name collision.
The tenant descriptor excludes admin-only endpoint keys while the admin descriptor may include both shared and admin-only bindings.
The endpoint_key enum is sorted deterministically.
A single-binding public tool remains callable without endpoint_key.
The selected parent_action_key, endpoint_key, and method belong to the requested binding only.
SYSTEM_TOOL_DESCRIPTOR_NAME_COLLISION remains unchanged for genuinely conflicting descriptors.

phases.objective: Preserve deterministic bounded lookup, structured non-secret selection errors, generated frontend evidence, and explicit Admin/Tenant route guards.

e2e_journeys.actor: platform operator validating Admin and Tenant system-tool surfaces
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: System-layer discovery and call handlers plus generated frontend dispatch governance
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Operational checks prove a bounded ordered candidate lookup, exact binding selection, current generated evidence, and structured errors with secrets_included=false.
steps: Load at most 200 visible bindings ordered by endpoint_key and parent_action_key.
Validate that candidate rows resolve to exactly one public tool name.
Return allowed_endpoint_keys when a multi-binding call omits or misstates endpoint_key.
Retain the explicit admin-required check after selection.
Expose error.details through the shared system-layer error envelope.
Regenerate frontend operation governance and surface-dispatch evidence from the exact candidate head.
assertions: The runtime no longer uses LIMIT 2 as a proxy for public-name uniqueness.
The runtime does not select rows[0] without a cardinality proof.
Missing endpoint_key returns platform_endpoint_tool_endpoint_key_required with the visible allowed keys.
Admin-only selected bindings remain forbidden to non-admin principals.
Generated frontend evidence is byte-current for the changed route and test manifest.

phases.objective: Fail closed on missing, unknown, cross-name, or genuinely duplicate selected bindings while preserving tenant isolation and the existing catalog collision invariant.

e2e_journeys.actor: tenant or admin caller submitting incomplete or conflicting endpoint selection
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Invalid or ambiguous selection is rejected with a typed non-secret response and no provider or endpoint dispatch occurs.
steps: Attempt a multi-binding call without endpoint_key.
Attempt a call with an endpoint_key outside the visible principal-scoped set.
Attempt selection from candidate rows spanning more than one public tool name.
Attempt selection where the requested endpoint_key still resolves to duplicate active rows.
Verify tenant projection never includes an admin-only endpoint key.
Verify the catalog's genuine descriptor collision guard remains fail-closed.
assertions: Missing selection is rejected with HTTP-compatible status 400 and platform_endpoint_tool_endpoint_key_required.
Unknown selection is rejected with HTTP-compatible status 400 and platform_endpoint_tool_endpoint_key_unknown.
Cross-name candidates are rejected with platform_endpoint_tool_name_ambiguous.
A duplicate selected binding is rejected with status 409 and platform_endpoint_tool_binding_ambiguous.
No database row deletion, tool-name rewrite, provider call, migration apply, or in-memory durability fallback occurs.

phases.objective: Verify one descriptor and endpoint-key-selected dispatch against a non-production registry snapshot containing shared, tenant-visible, and admin-only bindings.
After governed promotion, verify the live Admin and Tenant /system/tools and /system/tools/call acceptance criteria against the exact deployed Production SHA.
